links.comparator_used: Single LLM (HIPAA-compliant GPT-4o) rating ICH presence from radiology reports
links.outcome: Matthews correlation coefficient (MCC) for LLM-derived ground truth of ICH presence, used to evaluate the AI triage tool, against manual review of 1,726 examples
links.effect: MCC (95% CI): Full-9 Ensemble 0.571 (0.552-0.591), Top-3 Ensemble 0.558 (0.537-0.579), Consensus 0.556 (0.539-0.574), GPT-4o 0.522 (0.500-0.543). No statistically significant differences among Top-3, Full-9 and Consensus (p > 0.05). Best single-model AUC 0.78 (llama3.3:70b and GPT-4o).
links.quote: Using MCC (95% CI) the ideal combination of LLMs were: Full-9 Ensemble 0.571 (0.552-0.591), Top-3 Ensemble 0.558 (0.537-0.579), Consensus 0.556 (0.539-0.574), and GPT4o 0.522 (0.500-0.543).

design_hint: LLM ensemble for automated post-deployment performance monitoring of AI triage tool
